title: Move the Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs
summary: Structure-pass job G2: move the Transport items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog; about 340 lines) verbatim into gh/transport.rs. Re-export them from gh/mod.rs so public paths stay unchanged. No behavior change. The audience is the verifier applying section 5 of structure-pass.md.

defaults_applied.how: verifier runs test list, tests, fmt and clippy
the test list and the retry tests exercise the moved code
CHANGELOG entry written for outside readers
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: G1 (gh.rs renamed to gh/mod.rs) has landed. The Glob in my copy found no gh files, so I could not read the source. Line ranges 36-374 come from the design doc and may have shifted.
Items used only inside the Transport row may need pub(super) or pub(crate) visibility so the rest of gh can still reach them. This is the minimum change needed and is not a behavior change.
The external_calls_guard WRAPPER prefix covers gh/, so the new file passes the guard.

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/transport.rs holds the Transport row items listed in structure-pass.md section 2.1 (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog) with the same text as before the move (git diff -M --color-moved shows only moved lines).
gh/mod.rs declares `mod transport;` and re-exports each moved public and pub(crate) item, so no file outside gh/ changes its import path. Only import lines are edited in test modules.
The report lists the caller-check Grep for each moved name's old path, as section 5 rule 5 requires.
Only gh/mod.rs, gh/transport.rs and CHANGELOG.md change. CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the move. No config, workflow or docs file other than CHANGELOG.md changes.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` and check that the test names match the list before the move. Run `cargo test --locked` and check that it passes, including the retry tests that use the moved code.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. Both must be clean.

out_of_scope: Moving any other row of structure-pass.md section 2.1 (G3 onward)
Updating docs paths such as docs/system-facts.md or docs/architecture.md
Any behavior, signature or visibility change beyond what re-exports need
